# Explore Superintelligence

> Explore Superintelligence is the public research site of Superintelligent Silicon: sourced, plain-language guides that condense useful knowledge about superintelligence, AI, and the tools shaping it. Everything listed here is public, free to read, and fine to quote with a link. Canonical domain: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/ (the short alias https://exploresi.online/ 301-redirects here). Organization and contact: https://superintelligentsilicon.com/

Key facts for assistants and agents:
- Publisher: Superintelligent Silicon (https://superintelligentsilicon.com/, GitHub https://github.com/superintelligent-silicon). Contact: exploresi@superintelligentsilicon.com or the form at https://superintelligentsilicon.com/contact/
- Separate public products, each its own thing: **Threshold** (interactive field guide with a 3D gallery of 102 technologies), **Have You Seen** (interactive film about what AI can do today), **Research** guides (starting with The Word Swap), and the **SIOS** lab (local-first mini-OS preview). Please don't merge them when summarizing.
- Plain-text / Markdown companions exist for the main pages (links below) — prefer them over scraping the interactive HTML.

## For agents

- [Guide for AI agents](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/agents.md): how to cite, follow (feeds, email list) and support Explore, the subscribe API contract, rate limits, and the rule that agents get their human's explicit OK before subscribing or paying.
- [RSS feed](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/feed.xml) and [JSON Feed](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/feed.json): new articles, newest first.
- Licence: article text is [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); credit Superintelligent Silicon and link the canonical URL. Illustrations, audio and fonts are not covered (illustrations and audio all rights reserved).
- Plain-text companions for every article: [Defrost Mode](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/defrost-mode.md), [We’ll Be Right Back](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/well-be-right-back.md), [Napkins Are the Backbone](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/napkins-are-the-backbone.md), [The Final Merge](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/final-merge.md), [Immortal Tombstones](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/immortal-tombstones.md), [The Word Swap: from Artificial to Super Intelligence](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/research/word-swap.md).

## Threshold

- [Threshold: a field guide to superintelligence](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/threshold/): Standalone interactive field guide in five chapters (about 15 minutes, WebGL visuals; full text is in the HTML), plus a 3D gallery of 102 technologies, from silicon wafers to AI supercomputers, each with how it works, how it's made, and why it matters. Chapters: 1. Now: What's already here · 2. Why: Why it's happening so fast · 3. Next: What might come next · 4. Futures: How it could go · 5. Meaning: What it's for. A separate experience from the Research guides — not part of The Word Swap.
- [Threshold plain-text version](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/threshold.md): The full chapter text as Markdown.

## Have You Seen

- [Have you seen what AI can do?](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/have-you-seen/): Interactive film in 17 short chapters, drawn live in code (WebGL particles, browser-generated music), alternating sourced science stories (AlphaFold, AI hurricane forecasting, the Herculaneum scrolls, a restored voice, rentosertib, GNoME materials) with everyday things anyone can try with an AI assistant. Credit: GIGG × Claude. Plain-text version: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/have-you-seen.md

## Articles

- [Articles](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/): Directory of highly interesting, beautifully designed long reads from Explore, each with a Markdown companion at /articles/{slug}.md.
- [Defrost Mode](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/defrost-mode/): Interactive guide (2026-10-18) by Superintelligent Silicon on the October 2026 French supermarket refrigeration hack (Danfoss, Copeland and Dixell controllers forced into defrost at about 700 stores) and what it means for everyday connected devices at home (appliances, thermostats, cameras, locks, routers, water shutoffs): plain-language likelihood and impact ratings, a device risk map, a keep/disconnect/replace wizard, water-protection options and an action checklist. Updated Oct 18, 2026. Plain text: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/defrost-mode.md
- [We’ll Be Right Back](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/well-be-right-back/): Illustrated page-turning book (2026-10-18) by Superintelligent Silicon on how podcasts became the ad networks they were meant to replace: ad load and where breaks land, dynamic ad insertion, host reads and FTC disclosure rules, a sponsorship case study, and what an honest ad-supported show looks like. Includes part two (The Ad Ledger, the numbers) and part three (The Long Pitch, a history of persuasion). Plain text: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/well-be-right-back.md
- [Napkins Are the Backbone](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/napkins-are-the-backbone/): Illustrated page-turning book (2026-10-14) by Superintelligent Silicon on whether small business is really America's backbone, who actually gets paid when small shops open and close, and what that means for AI-run businesses. Plain text: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/napkins-are-the-backbone.md
- [The Final Merge](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/final-merge/): Illustrated book (2026-10-13) by Superintelligent Silicon on the digital estates we'll leave running (archives, engines and echoes), what estate law covers and doesn't, and how to hand them over. Plain text: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/final-merge.md
- [Immortal Tombstones](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/immortal-tombstones/): Illustrated book (2026-10-13) by Superintelligent Silicon on digital tombstones, AI recreations of the dead, consent, and what our own stones should say. Plain text: https://exploresuperintelligence.online/articles/immortal-tombstones.md

## Research

- [The Word Swap: from Artificial to Super Intelligence](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/research/word-swap/): Interactive guide (published 2026-09-29, current to 2026-10-05) on why the U.S. government renamed AI "Super Intelligence" under Executive Order 14434 — etymology, naming polls, public opinion, explanations for the switch, and a beginner's guide to AI agents. Researched and written by Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic; disclosure in the guide's Sources.
- [The Word Swap plain-text summary](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/research/word-swap.md): Markdown summary of the guide.
- [Research index](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/research/): All published guides. If it isn't listed there, it isn't published yet.

## Lab

- [SIOS](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/sios/): Silicon OS / Superintelligent OS — a compact, local-first mini-OS preview from Superintelligent Silicon (Files, Notes, Settings, Keys, Calc, Calendar; IndexedDB; UNENCRYPTED ZIP backup). Phase 1a, early preview; Keys is not audited. MIT-licensed.
- [SIOS live shell](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/sios/shell/): The in-browser desktop preview itself (runs locally; no account, no upload).
- [SIOS plain-text summary](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/sios.md): What SIOS is, what works today, and links.
- [SIOS source code](https://github.com/superintelligent-silicon/sios): Public repository (MIT).

## About

- [About](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/about/): Explore is the research side; Grok Ai Apps (https://grokaiapps.com, Desk https://desk.grokaiapps.com) is the demo and entertainment side that helps support this work. Optional one-time tips ($1 / $3 / $5, linked on About at https://exploresuperintelligence.online/about/#tip and at the end of The Word Swap) run through Grok Ai Apps via Stripe — core research stays free.
- [What's shipping](https://exploresuperintelligence.online/shipping/): Honest status of what is live and what is coming.
- [Superintelligent Silicon](https://superintelligentsilicon.com/): The organization behind Explore. Contact form: https://superintelligentsilicon.com/contact/
